gloss: for what purpose; why; what for

definitions.gloss: for what purpose; why; what for
definitions.explanation: Asks the purpose or reason for an action, focused on intended outcome rather than cause. Often used rhetorically to question whether something is worthwhile.

examples.japanese: {何|なん}のために⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧?
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何|なん}のために⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: What is this machine used for?

examples.japanese: ⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{頑張|がんば}って→頑張る：01222_ganbaru⟧、{何|なん}のために⟦やっている→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からなく→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I've worked so hard that I no longer know what I'm doing it all for.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧ (what) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ (possessive) + ⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (for the sake of). Asks about purpose or goal, not about cause.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {何|なん}のために⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: what do we live for?
- {何|なん}のために⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: what is this used for
- {何|なん}のために⟦こんな→こんな：02881_konna⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: why on earth am I doing this

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦なぜ→なぜ：01484_naze⟧: why — asks about cause/reason; broader
- ⟦どうして→どうして：00834_doushite⟧: why, how come — colloquial; asks about cause
- {何故|なぜ}: why (formal) — written/formal variant of ⟦なぜ→なぜ：01484_naze⟧
- ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: what is the purpose? — formal/direct equivalent
